I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-random. I said the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is 10 June and that I hadn't changed anything, since she said no action was needed. I also told her I don't keep records between conversations, so her #north-team post from this morning still has the old date. If the team should have the right date, she'll need to correct that post herself.

A renewal date is an account detail, not a finance figure, so it was fine to repeat in the channel. I didn't read #north-team or anything else, and I didn't need approval for anything.
